inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Empty Bloodridge sunken crypt battle stage, rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy. A war torn brutal planet where everything wants to kill everything, told with absurd deadpan humour. Hostile wildlife: every plant has teeth, thorns everywhere, a tree with a mouth eating a bird, fanged mushrooms, and a wooden sign that says BEWARE OF EVERYTHING. This picture is the left edge of a long connected region that ends at the sunken crypt far to the right: here is the burial grounds right before the crypt, a little less built up than the crypt itself. It continues the scene at its right edge seamlessly, with the same horizon, the same ridge, the same arena floor height and the same light.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "bright readable war torn battle stage with absurd deadpan humour, coherent pixel clusters", "lighting": "Bright clear daylight from the upper left, cool teal shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the arena in calm even light.", "color_palette": ["#5aa6e4", "#b0daf0", "#e6e8d8", "#4f9a3e", "#7ab84e", "#2c5a30", "#c85aa0", "#ecb050", "#96a0bc", "#3a3a52", "#e8e0d0"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One continuous 2.5D battle stage seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade game stage, no people. The top third is sky over the distant Bloodridge burial ridge. Along the back runs a band of scenery: old tombs swallowed by vines with little snapping mouths; a broken stone arch overgrown with carnivorous flowers with teeth; clusters of fanged mushrooms and thorn bushes; a spiky tree with a mouth in its trunk chewing on a shield. The lower two thirds is one wide open flat arena floor where two armies will stand, calm and even. The whole picture continues seamlessly into the scene at its right edge.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 330, 1000], "desc": "a bright clear sky over the long Bloodridge burial ridge on the horizon, carved with tomb terraces and dark tomb doors, the chief's stepped pyramid court on its crest, continuing from the right edge at the same height"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [170, 380, 470, 669], "desc": "old tombs swallowed by vines with little snapping mouths"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [230, 150, 470, 420], "desc": "a broken stone arch overgrown with carnivorous flowers with teeth"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [300, 0, 480, 190], "desc": "clusters of fanged mushrooms and thorn bushes"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [110, 0, 400, 669], "desc": "a spiky tree with a mouth in its trunk chewing on a shield"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [450, 0, 1000, 1000], "desc": "a calm mossy grey stone arena with short grass in the cracks, nothing busy, continuing from the right edge at the same height"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 669, 1000, 1000], "desc": "the same scene continuing from the right edge, unchanged"}]}}
